csv_scope_of_work: The Mena, Arkansas Advertising and Promotion Commission (A&P Commission) is issuing this Request for Qualifications (RFQ) to identify and select a qualified hotel developer and/or operator to plan, finance, design, construct, and operate a new hotel in Downtown Mena on a 1.33-acre lot owned by the Commission. The A&P Commission invites experienced hotel development firms with demonstrated expertise in development, financing, design, construction, operations, and ownership of full-service or headquarters-style hotels to submit statements of qualifications for consideration.
title: Hotel Developer for Mena
short_description: RFQ for a developer/operator to deliver a new downtown hotel in Mena, Arkansas.
project_scope: Selection of a qualified hotel developer and/or operator to plan, finance, design, construct, and operate a new hotel on a 1.33-acre downtown site owned by the Mena Advertising and Promotion Commission. The hotel is described as a full-service or headquarters-style hotel; no gross floor area, room count, height, or structural spans are stated.
services: Developer-led design-build delivery including planning, financing, design, construction, operation, and ownership; disciplines requested: Design Build/Developer and Construction/Project Management.
relevance_explanation:
- Hotel building project with no stated structural complexity, long spans, or special lightweight structure.
- Procurement is primarily for a developer/operator rather than structural or specialist engineering services.
- Could involve a building team entry point, but the notice focuses on development, financing, and operations.
- No sustainability, innovation, or architecturally demanding features are described.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. Available basis for a rough estimate: new full-service or headquarters-style hotel on a 1.33-acre downtown site in Mena, Arkansas, but no room count, floor area, quality standard, or program details are provided, so a realistic estimate is not possible.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. Because the procurement is for a hotel developer/operator and no engineering scope, construction budget, or fee basis is stated, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible.
references_qualifications: Qualified hotel developer and/or operator with demonstrated expertise in development, financing, design, construction, operations, and ownership of full-service or headquarters-style hotels.
award_criteria: Not stated; RFQ seeks statements of qualifications from experienced hotel development firms.
